title: Delete Leaves With a Given Value
summary: Remove every leaf whose value equals target.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–3000 nodes. Node values and target are in [1,1000]. Input and output use level-order values with null for absent children and omitted trailing nulls.
contractDetails.output-checking: Invoke removeLeafNodes(root,target), then serialize the resulting tree. Preserve null child positions and reject cycles or shared nodes. Compare the final structure after cascading pruning.

statement: Remove every leaf whose value equals target. If those removals make another target-valued node into a leaf, remove it too. Continue until no such leaf remains and return the remaining root, which may be null.

examples.explanation: Removing leaf 2s also turns the left internal 2 into a removable leaf.
The only node does not match the target.

constraints: 1–3000 nodes. Node values and target are in [1,1000]. Input and output use level-order values with null for absent children and omitted trailing nulls.
hints: Conceptual: A node’s final leaf status depends on what remains below it.
Directional: Process children before deciding whether their parent survives.
Implementation: Update both child pointers from their processed results, then remove the current node only if both are absent and its value matches target.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(h) active traversal state. Fixed-capacity internal buffers allocate O(Nmax) storage, where Nmax=3000; dynamically growing stacks need O(h).
